claims.explanation: PETCM activates caspase-3 by relieving prothymosin-alpha (ProT) inhibition of apoptosome formation, so selectivity likely depends on the balance of apoptosome regulators and caspase-3 expression. TP53 mutation is strongly enriched in sensitive lines, possibly because p53 loss impairs DNA damage responses and lowers the threshold for caspase activation. Conversely, intact apoptotic or survival signaling (e.g., wild-type TP53, PTEN loss with intact caspase-3) may protect some lines.

PETCM targets caspase-3; higher expression may increase drug effect
ProT inhibits apoptosome formation; PETCM relieves this inhibition, so high ProT may require more drug
